metadata.title: Art Deco Gold Statuette Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A centered gold metallic statuette of a winged figure holding a rose, framed by a geometric Art Deco header on a solid black field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, vertically oriented gold statuette resembling a luxury car hood ornament, featuring a female figure whose raised arms transition into a blooming rose. The composition is anchored by a complex Art Deco header consisting of nested rectangles and parallel lines in gold, containing a large Roman numeral 'II' in a beveled metallic style.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical symmetry between the statuette and the header
High contrast between the reflective gold subject and the matte black background
Geometric rigidity of the frame vs. the organic curves of the rose and figure
Hierarchical dominance of the central Roman numeral within the header
coreInvariants: Polished gold metallic texture with high-contrast highlights
Art Deco geometric framing at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The statuette is centered and occupies the lower two-thirds of the vertical axis; the header occupies the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central Roman numeral 'II' acts as the primary anchor, followed by the face of the statuette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright central Roman numeral, moves down the vertical line of the statuette to the base, then back up to the horizontal text in the header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounds the central elements, emphasizing the metallic sheen.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright, reflective gold surfaces.

letterConstructionRules: High-contrast beveled effect for the central Roman numeral
Wide tracking for horizontal text strings
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numeral 'II' features a 3D beveled metallic treatment with internal shading
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, beveled Roman numeral paired with a clean, wide-tracked serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the small-cap serif feel and wide stance.
Provides the classic Roman serif proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with a centered, airbrushed gold statuette of a winged woman holding a rose, and a gold Art Deco geometric frame at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-tracked gold serif text within the side panels of the frame and a large beveled gold Roman numeral 'II' in the center square.

verificationChecks: Does the header use geometric Art Deco lines?
Is the gold texture reflective and metallic?

mustRedesign: Exact likeness of the statuette face

mustAchieve: Sharp geometric lines in the frame

postGenerationChecks: Verify the Roman numeral is beveled
Ensure text tracking is wide and even
Confirm the background is solid black without noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Gold metallic subject + Art Deco geometric header + Solid black field + Wide-tracked serif typography.
